meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：I would / would not go so far as to say that + complete clause。

rules.zh: 肯定形式用來加強判斷 I would go so far as to say that ... 比普通的 I think that ...、I believe that ... 或 In my view ... 更強烈。 （我認為信任很重要。） （我甚至會說，信任是一支優秀團隊的基礎。） 第二句不只是表達普通意見，而是刻意提出一個更有分量的判斷。
rules.en: The affirmative form strengthens a judgement. “I would go so far as to say that ...” is stronger than I think that ..., I believe that ... or In my view .... Compare: I think trust is important. I would go so far as to say that trust is the foundation of a good team. The second sentence deliberately advances a weightier claim rather than merely stating an ordinary opinion.
examples: I would go so far as to say that trust is the foundation of a good team.

rules.zh: 否定形式不一定表示完全相反 I would not go so far as to say that ... 通常不是說後面的內容完全錯誤，而是表示「這樣說太 盡、太強或太絕對」。 （新系統很實用，但我倒不至於說它具有革命性。） 說話者承認系統有用，只是不接受「具有革命性」這個過於強烈的評價。
rules.en: The negative form does not necessarily assert the complete opposite. “I would not go so far as to say that ...” normally means that the claim goes too far or is too strong or absolute. In “The new system is useful, but I would not go so far as to say that it is revolutionary”, the speaker accepts that the system is useful but rejects revolutionary as excessive.
examples: The new system is useful, but I would not go so far as to say that it is revolutionary.

rules.zh: so far 在這裏不表示距離或時間 在這個固定句型中，go so far as to say 的意思是「甚至說到……的程度」，而不是「走得這麼 遠」。
rules.en: So far does not refer to distance or time here; go so far as to say means to make a judgement this strong.

rules.zh: that 後面必須接完整子句 正確： 不完整：
rules.en: Follow that with a complete clause. Correct: I would go so far as to say that patience is a form of strength. Incomplete: I would go so far as to say that patience.
examples: I would go so far as to say that patience is a form of strength.
I would go so far as to say that patience.

rules.zh: 本練習保留完整形式 日常口語中可以使用： 但本練習的參考答案統一使用完整形式：
rules.en: Keep the full form in this exercise. “I wouldn’t go so far as to say that ...” is natural in everyday speech, but the model answers consistently use “I would not go so far as to say that ....”

rules.zh: 句型可以放在背景資料之後 （雖然結果令人鼓舞，但我倒不至於說問題已經解決。） 前面的內容提供背景，目標句型則清楚顯示說話者願意接受甚麼程度的判斷。
rules.en: The structure can follow background information: Although the results are encouraging, I would not go so far as to say that the problem has been solved. The opening supplies context, while the target structure marks exactly how strong a judgement the speaker will accept.
examples: Although the results are encouraging, I would not go so far as to say that the problem has been

benefits.zh: 準確控制說法的強弱 這個句型能讓你清楚表示自己正在提出一個非常強烈的觀點，或刻意拒絕一個過於強烈的說法。 你不只是說「同意」或「不同意」，而是能表達自己願意把判斷推到甚麼程度。
benefits.en: It precisely controls claim strength by marking either a very strong judgement or a deliberate refusal to make an excessive one. Rather than merely agreeing or disagreeing, you show exactly how far you are willing to take the claim.

benefits.zh: 讓強烈觀點更有鋪排 直接說： 語氣可能十分斬釘截鐵。 使用： 可以讓讀者先知道這是一個經過考慮的強烈判斷，而不是隨意說出的絕對事實。
benefits.en: It prepares the reader for a strong view. The direct “Trust is the most important part of a team” can sound categorical. “I would go so far as to say that trust is the most important part of a team” signals that the speaker is making a considered, deliberately strong judgement rather than stating a casual absolute.

benefits.zh: 可以有禮貌地反對過度誇張的說法 直接說： 只是簡單否定。 使用： 能清楚表示：你承認計劃可能有問題，但認為「完全失敗」這個評價太過分。 這在討論、辯論、會議及回應別人意見時特別實用。
benefits.en: It politely rejects an exaggerated claim. “The plan is not a complete failure” simply denies the claim. “I would not go so far as to say that the plan is a complete failure” acknowledges that the plan may have problems while treating complete failure as too strong. This is useful in discussions, debates, meetings and responses to other people’s views.

benefits.zh: 適合表達平衡而有分寸的觀點 在作文、報告或口語討論中，你經常需要承認部分事實，同時避免作出過度絕對的結論。 （證據很有希望，但我倒不至於說它已具有決定性。） 這種表達能顯示你有考慮證據的限制，而不是草率下結論。
benefits.en: It supports balanced, measured opinions. In essays, reports or discussions, you may need to acknowledge some evidence without drawing an absolute conclusion: The evidence is promising, but I would not go so far as to say that it is conclusive. This shows awareness of the evidence’s limits.

benefits.zh: 避免反覆使用 I think 或 I disagree 這個句型提供另一種自然的表達方式，讓你的說話和寫作不會不斷重複： 它尤其適合用來提出有分量的判斷，以及委婉地限制別人的說法。
benefits.en: It avoids repeatedly using I think, I strongly think, I disagree or I do not think. The frame offers a natural alternative for advancing a substantial judgement or tactfully limiting someone else’s claim.

benefits.zh: 為即席說話提供完整框架 當你需要在討論或面試中迅速表達立場時，可以直接使用以下框架： 你只需把主要觀點放進空格，便能建立一個清晰、有組織而語氣準確的回答。
benefits.en: It provides complete frames for spontaneous speaking: I would go so far as to say that ______. I would not go so far as to say that ______. Insert the main point to produce a clear, organised answer with accurately calibrated tone while speaking or interviewing.
